subtheme: Getting models to follow detailed instructions better

subsubthemes.name: Teaching through examples and preferences
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that learn from human preferences and example rankings to guide model behavior, rather than writing rules directly.

subsubthemes.name: Fine-tuning for specific skills
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that adjust pre-trained models for particular tasks or domains using training data focused on those skills.

subsubthemes.name: Learning from feedback and examples
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that improve models by analyzing human feedback, comparisons, and self-evaluation to spot mistakes.

subsubthemes.name: Picking better training data
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that identify and select the most useful examples for training so models learn faster and better.

subsubthemes.name: Adapting models for different users
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that personalize models to match individual preferences and communication styles instead of one-size-fits-all.

subsubthemes.name: Keeping knowledge across different tasks
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that prevent models from forgetting earlier skills when learning new ones, especially in multimodal and continual settings.

subsubthemes.name: Better ways to measure and improve reasoning
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that evaluate model thinking more carefully and improve step-by-step reasoning through better feedback.
